---
name: Bug report
about: Describe unexpected behavior with a minimal reproduction.
labels: bug
---

Use the sections that help explain the bug; delete anything inapplicable.
Keep credentials and private runtime evidence (including receipts and delivery payloads) out of public issues.

## Observed and expected behavior

What happened, and what should have happened instead?

## Minimal reproduction

Give the smallest steps or command that reproduce the problem, using synthetic inputs.
Include the engine commit or version and relevant Python/OS details.

## Impact

Which workflow is affected, and what does the failure prevent or change?

## Safe evidence

Add synthetic examples or redacted error excerpts that clarify the failure.

Context: [Contributing](https://github.com/Lenivvenil/digest/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
and the [domain model](https://github.com/Lenivvenil/digest/blob/main/docs/domain/digest/overview.md).
